name: Welcoming
overview: Scripture teaches that welcoming others, especially strangers and those in need, is a vital expression of love and obedience to God. Leviticus commands believers to treat strangers as if they were native-born, loving them as themselves because of God's past mercy. Jesus reinforces this in Matthew by identifying acts of kindness toward strangers as service to Himself, highlighting the personal nature of hospitality. The New Testament further emphasizes impartiality and generous hospitality among believers, reflecting the heart of God who shows no favoritism.
